description: SECDED(72,64) memory ECC: encode 64 data bits into 8 check bits, verify a received 72-bit word, correct a single-bit error and flag a double-bit error
hardware_advantage: the 8 syndromes are produced by eight parallel AND/reduction-XOR trees over one 64-bit data word, so SECDED encode and decode finish in a single cycle with no multiplier: every fold is carry-free XOR and the only arithmetic is a +1 counter, letting the data word and its check bits be inferred straight into a BRAM ECC row
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
